brief: A shelf unit rated to hold 50 kg of books, with two drawers.
costSource: token-equivalent at Muse Spark Open shared rates, info only: the Dedicated Endpoint bills GPU seconds while up (.spend/modal-dedicated.jsonl)

requirements.evidence: Upper storey provides flat shelf deck formed by 4 solid covers: cover:0,0,1;full;top, cover:1,-1,1;full;top, cover:1,-2,1;full;top, cover:1,0,1;full;top (deck f23 310x310mm, y=160mm) and lower base structure (pieces at 0,0,0; 1,0,0; 1,-1,0; 1,-2,0). Props book-stack x2 and book-row x1 staged on shelves demonstrate intended book storage. Build measures 364x160x632mm parts, 405mm tall with props, check_build meshClash clear.

requirements.requirement: Rated to hold 50 kg of books
requirements.evidence: The configurator only checks geometric fit and mesh collision, not strength, stiffness, or load rating. Parts are 3D-printed plastic in user-chosen material and are not tested or certified to any load rating. No 50 kg rating can be claimed or verified in this system. The geometry provides flat cover shelves that can hold light display books for staging, but structural capacity for 50 kg is unmet.

Two drawers installed on half-base cut faces: drawer:0#0,-1#cut at 0,-1,0;half-n and drawer:0#0,-2#cut at 0,-2,0;half-n, each with cover top closing the cell above and interior floor/compartment surfaces for storage.

finish.summary: Built a hexagonal shelf unit with a 4-cell upper shelf deck displaying books, plus two drawers in half-base cells at one end, caps and joint bolts applied. Geometry for book storage and drawers is present and verified (check_build clear, look confirms props visible). The requested 50 kg load rating cannot be met in Hex Cluster — the system does not model materials, strength, or load ratings and the 3D-printed parts are not certified; do not load with heavy books without independent engineering verification.

M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.

events.text: Your shelf-and-drawer unit is up next — I'll check the system and lay out a two-drawer design while flagging that 50 kg rating honestly.

result.note: Ask again with a family or a few words (text) to see the parts themselves.

A drawer sits on the cut face of a half base: place a half base (variant half-n, half-s, half-e or half-w) first. No place on the build takes this part right now. Change the build so it can (for example add the cells it needs beside or below it), then ask again. Guessing raw ops for a part with no offers rarely works.
